'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****The [[World Health Organization]] says that medicine and health supplies have not been delivered to three hospitals in northern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and that nearly two-thirds of hospitals in Gaza are now inoperable. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/23/israel-hamas-war-live-hundreds-killed-israeli-strikes-gaza (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-palestinian-refugee-agency-calls-unimpeded-flow-aid-gaza-2023-10-24/ (Reuters)] 
****The [[UNRWA|UN agency for Palestinian refugees]] says that the number of aid trucks so far is "a trickle in the face of the immense needs of people" and calls for an "unimpeded and continuous flow of [[humanitarian assistance]] and medical assistance to continue coming into Gaza". [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-palestinian-refugee-agency-calls-unimpeded-flow-aid-gaza-2023-10-24/ (Reuters)]
***[[Israel]] launches [[airstrike]]s near the [[International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement|Red Crescent]] headquarters and Al-Amal Hospital in [[Khan Younis]], where more than 4,000 displaced [[Palestinians]] are taking shelter. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/24/israel-hamas-war-live-fuel-shortfall-could-force-un-to-halt-work-in-gaza-2 (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Secretary-General of the United Nations|UN Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]] calls for an immediate humanitarian [[ceasefire]] in Gaza, saying that there are clear violations of [[international humanitarian law]]. Guterres also called for more [[humanitarian relief]] to be allowed into the enclave. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/23/israel-hamas-war-live-hundreds-killed-israeli-strikes-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Human Rights Watch]] criticizes [[Israel]] for "deliberately deepening the suffering of civilians in Gaza" by refusing to allow shipments of fuel into the enclave and for not restoring the supply of water. [https://www.tbsnews.net/hamas-israel-war/eu-leaders-focus-fallout-hamas-attack-israel-720470 (The Business Standard)] 
***[[Israeli police]] close the [[Al-Aqsa Mosque]] in [[East Jerusalem]] and stop [[Muslim]] worshippers from entering the compound. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20231024-israel-bans-muslims-from-al-aqsa-mosque/ (Middle East Monitor)]
*[[Iraqi conflict]]
**Two rockets land inside [[Al-Asad Airbase]] in [[Al Anbar Governorate]], [[Iraq]], which houses [[United States Armed Forces|American troops]], no casualties are reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/rockets-attack-targets-iraqi-base-housing-us-forces-sources-2023-10-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] warns [[Iran]] of a "decisive response" if [[Americans]] are attacked by its proxies in [[Middle East|the region]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-10-24/blinken-warns-iran-of-decisive-response-if-americans-are-attacked (Bloomberg)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**IDF airstrikes attacks two Syrian military positions in southwestern Syria, marking the first time the IDF publicly targeted the Syrian military since the Israel-Gaza war began.[https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/iran-update-october-25-2023 (UnderstandingWar)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Heligoland ship collision]]
**One person is killed and four others are missing after two [[cargo ship]]s, the [[British ensign|British-flagged]] ''Verity'' and the [[Bahamas]]-flagged ''Polesie'', [[Ship collision|collide]] in the [[North Sea]] near [[Heligoland]], [[Schleswig-Holstein]], [[Germany]], with the ''Verity'' sinking. Rescue efforts are ongoing. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231024-one-dead-four-missing-after-two-cargo-ships-collide-in-north-sea (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Crime in Norway]]
**Tuesday night the Norwegian police received a report of a bomb that went off at the entrance of a house in [[Drøbak]], [[Norway]]. The police tells the media that they do not know what they are facing in the case. No one was injured or killed in the incident. [https://norway.postsen.com/news/138677/Report-of-an-explosion-in-a-residential-building.html (Norway Posts)]
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
**[[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
***Former [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] [[White House Chief of Staff|chief of staff]] [[Mark Meadows]] is granted immunity by prosecutor [[Jack Smith (lawyer)|Jack Smith]] in exchange for testifying to a grand jury earlier this year. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/chief-staff-mark-meadows-granted-immunity-tells-special/story?id=104231281 (ABC News)]
*[[Christchurch mosque shootings]]
**The deputy [[Chief Coroner of New Zealand|chief coroner]] of [[New Zealand]] opens an [[inquest]] into the shootings in order to investigate [[New Zealand Police|police]] [[Emergency service#Response time|response times]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/10/25/world/asia-oceania/new-zealand-inquest-into-mosque-massacre-opened/1916315 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*Authorities in [[Touboro]], [[North Region (Cameroon)|North Region]], [[Cameroon]], report that a number of travellers from [[Ngaoundéré]] have been [[kidnapping|kidnapped]] yesterday by unidentified gunmen near the border with [[Chad]], bringing the number to at least 50 people for the past two days. Seven of them have been released. [https://www.voaafrica.com/a/gunmen-kidnap-at-least-50-people-in-northern-cameroon-/7324549.html (AP via VOA)]
*Three people are killed in a shootout in [[Cotabato City]], [[Philippines]], while posting [[2023 Philippine barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections|election]] posters, leading to the arrest of 12 suspects. [https://www.benarnews.org/english/news/philippine/three-killed-in-philippine-election-violence-10242023070136.html (BenarNews)]
*The [[Holy See]] announces [[Bishops in the Catholic Church|Bishop]] [[Grzegorz Kaszak]]'s resignation from the [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Sosnowiec|Diocese of Sosnowiec]] in [[Catholic Church in Poland|Poland]] following allegations related to a [[Priesthood in the Catholic Church|priest]]'s misconduct in [[Dąbrowa Górnicza]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/10/26/world/americas-emea/polish-bishop-resigns-after-priest-orgy-scandal/1916484 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[October 2023 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election]]
**The [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] party selects [[Tom Emmer]] as their nominee for [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives]]. However, Emmer withdraws four hours later. The same party conference again gathers and selects [[Mike Johnson (Louisiana politician)|Mike Johnson]] as their nominee for Speaker. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/house-speaker-vote-10-24-23/index.html (CNN)]
*The [[Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of China]] votes to remove several [[State Council of the People's Republic of China|state council]] members from their positions, including [[Minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China|defense minister]] [[Li Shangfu]], [[Ministry of Finance (China)|finance minister]] [[Liu Kun]], and [[Ministry of Science and Technology (China)|science minister]] [[Wang Zhigang]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/china-defence-minister-li-shangfu-qin-gang-removed-3869026 (Reuters via CNA)]
